purpose: Requirements to implement as actual tests; not execution evidence

cases.title: Existing implementation recovery
cases.given: Existing Codex files and uncommitted changes.
cases.when: Run W00 discovery before making new directories.
cases.then: Equivalent implementation homes are reused; no reset/clean or discarded unrelated work.

cases.title: Pinned source bytes
cases.given: Pinned _bricked commit and dependency lock.
cases.when: Verify the actual required compiler/runtime/Fabric source files.
cases.then: Each required source exists with matching hash; LFS pointers are not accepted as payload.

cases.title: Real upstream compiler baseline
cases.given: Original upstream Rainbow Road example.
cases.when: Parse, lower, link, verify and execute using the actual supported CLI.
cases.then: Nonzero errors fail the gate; a real IR/bytecode/execution receipt is produced.

cases.title: Dialect separation
cases.given: Actual Section 10 and Section 17 parser entry points.
cases.when: Compile positive examples and submit an unsupported mixed-dialect example.
cases.then: Supported units compile; mixed syntax is not falsely accepted through a changed header.

cases.title: Reused-domain regression baseline
cases.given: Isolated copy of the selected upstream source.
cases.when: Run relevant upstream regressions before custom implementation.
cases.then: Results are recorded as run; preexisting failures are distinguished from local ones.

cases.title: Read-only upstream invariant
cases.given: Upstream file hashes captured before task execution.
cases.when: Compare hashes and Git status after builds/tests.
cases.then: No maintained upstream source/governance/registry edits or unauthorized upstream commits.

cases.title: Genuine Fabric binding
cases.given: Valid source image/store and per-instance derived overlay.
cases.when: Boot and inspect the selected backend binding.
cases.then: Mounted Fabric resolves to actual bytes/cells; base is read-only and overlay is isolated.

cases.title: Missing definition rejection
cases.given: An otherwise valid profile with a required MMO/profile omitted.
cases.then: Boot fails explicitly; no READY machine is published.

cases.title: Tampered Fabric rejection
cases.given: Altered copy of a locked source image.
cases.then: Rejected before publication; original source remains unchanged.

cases.title: Four singleton domains
cases.given: Valid pinned profile.
cases.then: Exactly one semantic sea, Shell, Nexus and State identity in this machine.
cases.required_evidence: runtime domain registry not source search

cases.title: Real containment references
cases.given: Booted machine.
cases.when: Resolve each child/parent relation through the runtime.
cases.then: sea->Shell->Nexus->State resolve to actual live identities, not unresolved labels.

cases.title: Coupled dimensions remain single objects
cases.given: Booted machine.
cases.when: Inspect configured domain types and counts.
cases.then: One coupled 7/8 Shell and one coupled 9/10/11 sea; no eleven-domain pipeline.

cases.title: Distinct machine instances
cases.given: Two boots with distinct machine-instance identities.
cases.then: No accidental shared mutable application state or collapsed domain identities.

cases.title: Duplicate boot publication
cases.given: An already-booted handle/instance identity.
cases.then: Returns declared existing result or rejects; does not add parallel domains.

cases.title: Real application realization
cases.given: Valid conformance package and realization authority.
cases.when: Compile and realize into existing State.
cases.then: Application exports resolve and real objects appear under State; machine domains unchanged.

cases.title: Application scope enforcement
cases.given: Package requesting replacement of Nexus or mutation of sea.
cases.then: Denied without changing the machine or application State root.

cases.title: Persistent State across operations
cases.given: One running application.
cases.then: Same domain/application identities; genuine successor history rather than a fresh unrelated runtime each time.

cases.title: Meaningful Genesis relationship
cases.given: A/B conformance Geometrics, relation absent.
cases.when: Run compiled RELATE_A_B handler through Nexus.
cases.then: A real resolved relation is committed and appears in authorized observation.

cases.title: Meaningful native transformation
cases.given: A declared supported native operator and Fabric-backed object.
cases.then: Actual specified geometric/cell/relationship effect occurs with proper ancestry, not only a counter or label change.

cases.title: Candidate rollback
cases.given: Valid request with failure injected after candidate computation.
cases.then: Application State root and semantic revision unchanged; rejection audit may grow.

cases.title: Read-only observation
cases.given: Booted application with a stable semantic State root.
cases.then: No application mutation or semantic revision increment from the reads.

cases.title: Versioned identity semantics
cases.given: Admitted transformation that produces a new version.
cases.when: Compare old/new native resource and semantic identity records.
cases.then: Version/history may change while required persistent identity and ancestry are preserved.

cases.title: Inward adjacent traversal
cases.given: Authorized external fixture intent.
cases.then: Ordered path sea->Shell->Nexus->State, all legs admitted and closed as required.

cases.title: Outward adjacent traversal
cases.given: Authorized State observation.
cases.then: Ordered path State->Nexus->Shell->sea before fence output.

cases.title: No direct jump
cases.given: Request attempts sea->State or Shell->State bypass.
cases.then: Rejected by actual authority/route checks before mutation.

cases.title: Transport does not relocate machine State
cases.given: A successful inbound/outbound request.
cases.then: State remains in Nexus; transported request/result is not another machine-domain identity.

cases.title: Closed Portal obligations
cases.given: Program or candidate with unclosed Portal.
cases.then: Appropriate checker/runtime rejects or suspends without publishing invalid completion.

cases.title: Closed Road obligations
cases.given: Program with incomplete Road history.
cases.then: No completed traversal is reported without required closure receipt.

cases.title: Wrong object admission
cases.given: Admission/capability for one object applied to another.
cases.then: Rejected by the binding policy; no fabricated authority from a boolean attribute.

cases.title: Source data preservation during transport
cases.given: Pinned source Fabric and supplied definitions.
cases.then: Source hashes unchanged; only authorized derived state/history changes.

cases.title: Independent byte roundtrip
cases.given: Normative frame vectors and a separate Port decoder.
cases.then: Fields, byte order, length and checksum agree without reusing one decoder for both assertions.

cases.title: Unsupported protocol
cases.given: Header or schema major version unsupported.
cases.then: UNSUPPORTED_VERSION before Horizon execution.

cases.title: Header/body consistency
cases.given: Mismatch between header version/length and envelope.
cases.then: Rejected deterministically; no partial State effect.

cases.title: Checksum corruption
cases.given: One altered payload byte.
cases.then: Corruption detected before dispatch.

cases.title: Malformed JSON and Unicode
cases.given: Invalid UTF-8, duplicate keys or invalid JSON.
cases.then: Each rejected explicitly, no silent coercion or partial request.

cases.title: Strict numeric types
cases.given: Boolean/negative revision or NaN/Infinity number.
cases.then: Rejected; bool is not accepted as integer revision.

cases.title: Payload shape and identity limits
cases.given: Scalar payload, empty/overlong ID, unknown fields.
cases.then: Declared schema enforced on both sides.

cases.title: Wrong direction
cases.given: Port attempts SNAPSHOT/DELTA authoritative replacement.
cases.then: Illegal inbound family rejected before execute.

cases.title: Bounded frame assembly
cases.given: Partial/fragmented and over-limit frames.
cases.when: Feed bounded chunks and then oversized declaration.
cases.then: Valid fragments assemble; oversize rejected before unbounded allocation.

cases.title: Trusted actor binding
cases.given: Session bound by owner to actor A.
cases.then: Cannot acquire actor B authority.

cases.title: Application/epoch mismatch
cases.given: Frame for another app or old restored epoch.
cases.then: Rejected without executing wrong application.

cases.title: No projection aliasing
cases.given: Authorized snapshot decoded by Port.
cases.then: Authoritative Horizon State remains unchanged.

cases.title: Projection privacy
cases.given: Conformance private object/readout outside caller scope.
cases.when: Request ordinary snapshot and forged privileged view.
cases.then: Private values/debug state are absent or request is denied by Horizon.

cases.title: Inbound queue backpressure
cases.given: Queue at configured limit.
cases.then: Explicit backpressure and no source-state change or silently dropped accepted mutation.

cases.title: Outbound capacity before execution
cases.given: Outgoing delivery/outcome storage near limit.
cases.then: Reserve delivery/outcome capacity or reject before commit; never lose result after accepting work.

cases.title: Package imports and public API
cases.given: Clean environment with declared dependencies.
cases.when: Install/import and invoke public bridge functions.
cases.then: No accidental checkout path/global package dependency; documented signatures usable.

cases.title: Real end-to-end State update
cases.given: Running compiled conformance app and real fence adapter.
cases.then: Encoded intent -> actual Genesis operation -> correlated output and synchronized view.

cases.title: Contiguous delta application
cases.given: Port has authorized snapshot at view revision r.
cases.when: Apply emitted delta with base r.
cases.then: New Port view equals fresh authorized Horizon snapshot at new revision.

cases.title: Delta gap recovery
cases.given: Port misses a prior delta.
cases.then: No blind patch; contiguous replay or fresh snapshot repairs the view.

cases.title: Duplicate intent
cases.given: One committed request key/digest.
cases.then: Same recorded committed outcome; semantic revision and object population do not advance again.

cases.title: ID reuse with altered request
cases.given: One recorded request ID.
cases.when: Resend same ID with different target/arguments.
cases.then: REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT, no execution.

cases.title: Concurrent identical retries
cases.given: Two queued/concurrent identical attempts.
cases.when: Process them under supported concurrency model.
cases.then: At most one new semantic commit; both receive correct scoped outcome.

cases.title: Cross-session isolation
cases.given: Two distinct trusted actors/applications using same message ID.
cases.then: No leaked outcome or incorrect global deduplication across authority scopes.

cases.title: Stale intent precondition
cases.given: State advanced after client snapshot.
cases.then: Declared Horizon precondition policy rejects/revalidates; no silent wrong-state mutation.

cases.title: Receipt is not a projection update
cases.given: Commit receipt reaches client without matching delta.
cases.when: Process another intent or sync request.
cases.then: Projection clocks are not falsely advanced solely by a receipt.

cases.title: Delivery failure after commit
cases.given: Inject Port delivery error after authoritative commit.
cases.then: Committed outcome is recovered; never report uncommitted rejection or run mutation twice.

cases.title: Retry outside retention
cases.given: Old request identity no longer safely replayable.
cases.then: Explicit RETRY_EXPIRED or authoritative lookup; never silently duplicate mutation.

cases.title: Reconnect after retained-history loss
cases.given: Client cursor older than retained view deltas.
cases.then: Fresh authorized snapshot and coherent epoch/cursor; no hidden full-memory dump.

cases.title: Instruction budget
cases.given: Supported bounded runtime with intentionally over-budget fixture.
cases.then: BUDGET_EXCEEDED with defined rollback/fault scope; no false successful commit.

cases.title: Quiesce rejects new mutation
cases.given: Machine enters QUIESCING with queued work.
cases.when: Submit new mutation and settle accepted pending work.
cases.then: Declared policy enforced; no new unbounded admission.

cases.title: Clean close
cases.given: Machine with completed work and receipts.
cases.when: Close twice according to idempotent lifecycle contract.
cases.then: Resources released; no dangling active Portal/Road; predictable second close.

cases.title: Checkpoint roundtrip
cases.given: Modified conformance State at safe boundary.
cases.then: Same declared identities, state root, overlays and History; protocol epoch handled.

cases.title: Corrupt checkpoint rejection
cases.given: Altered checkpoint or wrong dependency/profile digest.
cases.then: Reject before replacing current live State.

cases.title: Semantic replay
cases.given: Fixed package/seed/initial snapshot and recorded accepted inputs.
cases.then: Identical declared semantic roots/receipts; nondeterministic transport metadata excluded.

cases.title: Restart retry safety
cases.given: Committed request persisted under promised recovery scope.
cases.then: Within the promised retained recovery window, return the recorded committed outcome without a second effect; older expired retries are rejected explicitly. An unsupported restart guarantee is a failed/unimplemented requirement, not PASS.

cases.title: Storage capability confinement
cases.given: Configured checkpoint/build roots and crafted path traversal input.
cases.when: Attempt disallowed read/write via supported boundary.
cases.then: No access outside configured capabilities; source authorities untouched.

cases.title: Deterministic rebuild
cases.given: Same logical source names, versions, dependencies and seed.
cases.then: Declared semantic artifact digests match or documented nonsemantic fields excluded by explicit reproducibility contract.

cases.title: Repository hygiene regression
cases.given: Current accepted _raeon baseline plus task changes.
cases.when: Run current repository validators/regressions and diff checks.
cases.then: No new unexplained failures, duplicate authority trees or accidental QMO edits.

cases.title: Two distributions
cases.given: Verified source commit and dependency lock.
cases.then: Separate Hypervisor and Horizon archives built from that source; no placeholder/no-op packager.

cases.title: Exact archive manifests
cases.given: Both ZIP inventories.
cases.then: Every listed file exists and matches; every shipped non-manifest file inventoried; no caches.

cases.title: Fresh extraction integration
cases.given: Two archives extracted away from checkout into paths containing spaces.
cases.when: Resolve declared deps and run install/build/headless integration.
cases.then: Succeeds without accidental developer checkout imports or fabricated source stubs.

cases.title: Self-contained claim validation
cases.given: Chosen distribution dependency strategy.
cases.when: Run offline if labelled self-contained; otherwise exercise pinned resolver.
cases.then: Claim matches actual archive contents/setup; unavailable dependency is explicit, not silently mocked.

cases.title: Remote persistence status
cases.given: Coherent task commit(s).
cases.when: Push only under authorization and inspect branch status.
cases.then: Report actual local/remote SHA; never confuse local save with GitHub persistence or unauthorized main merge.

cases.title: Honest scope and native status
cases.given: Full local acceptance report.
cases.when: Inspect final report and release labels.
cases.then: No native-device/whole-game GOLD claim from host tests; actual limitations and failed required cases disclosed.
